title: ZONE GAP: surgical/acute oral photo datasets — structurally absent from open corpora
notes: 15+ queries en+ru+zh+pt+es+tr yield: (a) DentalTraumaGuide Copenhagen/IADT paywalled; (b) Andreasen Color Atlas copyrighted Wiley; (c) MRONJ AI lit ALL panoramic/CBCT; (d) Odontogenic cellulitis/phlegmon = scattered CC-BY case figures (MDPI IJERPH PMC10049628); (e) Oroantral fistula = case series CC-BY-NC-ND; (f) Drug-induced gingival overgrowth = embedded case figures; (g) NUG = Atlas Emergency Medicine McGraw-Hill (copyrighted); (h) Peri-implantitis+pus = 0; (i) Dry socket = 0; (j) Bone sequestrum = BMC case reports. CONCLUSION: structurally underserved; photos live in paywalled textbooks (Andreasen, Peterson, Neville) and per-paper figures. Use PMC CC-BY figure-harvest in iter_5, not keyword search.
